category: cheap-egress VPS: KVM VPS with a metered monthly allowance and a 1 Gbps port

free_tier.stated: No free tier. The Ryzen 1 Core, 512MB, 15GB NVMe plan lists 1TB of monthly data at 1Gbps for $2.50 a month.

per_object_cap.stated: not applicable: a VPS, not an object store

egress.terms: 1 TB a month at 1 Gbps. Going over the allocation suspends the service until the counter resets; a service may not use more than 50% of its monthly allocation in under 14 days or more than 10% in under 24 hours; extra data is sold at 500 GB for a one-time USD 10.00.
egress.free_allowance: 1 TB per month, reset on the first day of the month or at the recurring payment date
egress.price_per_tb: USD 10.00 for 500 GB of extra data, one time

tooling: Any SSH client; the root VPS takes any protocol that its kernel runs.
chaining: A 1 TB, 1 Gbps KVM box on a public IPv4. The terms cap simultaneous connection tracking at 50,000 sessions and port bursts at 80% of the port speed for 5 minutes in a row or 24 hours a month, which a relay or a WireGuard endpoint has to stay under. The terms print no list of blocked ports.

limits.value: 1 TB per month; exceeding it suspends the service until the reset; extra data 500 GB for USD 10.00 one time

no more than 50% of the monthly allocation in under 14 days, no more than 10% in under 24 hours, no more than 50,000 conntrack sessions, no burst at or above 80% of the port speed for more than 5 minutes in a row or 24 hours a month

binding_note: The 1 TB allowance is reached first for a transit of 1 TiB a month, and the terms also stop a draw of 10% of it in a day, so a steady 1 TiB a month relay needs the paid extra data.

identity_cost.detail: Orders pass through automated fraud protection and need correct billing information; the accepted payment methods are unverified: behind a sign-up.

reliability_note: A service that goes over its allocation is suspended and unsuspends at the next reset.
